- **Repository scanning under src/scanner** (high confidence): Repository loading and scanning live under src/scanner.
- **Source code under src/** (high confidence): Application source code lives under the src/ directory.
- **Technology detection under src/detectors** (high confidence): Technology detection lives under src/detectors.
- **src/analyzers consume the PKM** (high confidence): Analyzers enrich the PKM deterministically without re-scanning the repository.
- **src/core orchestrates the pipeline** (high confidence): The core module drives pipeline execution and coordinates every stage.
- **src/detectors feed upstream knowledge** (high confidence): Detectors identify the technology stack that informs downstream analysis.
- **src/docs writes derived output** (high confidence): The docs module plans and renders documentation generated from the PKM.
- **src/domain remains pure** (high confidence): The domain module contains only types and declarative data — no runtime behavior.
- **src/knowledge owns the PKM** (high confidence): The knowledge module defines, assembles, and persists the Project Knowledge Model.
- **src/scanner feeds upstream knowledge** (high confidence): The scanner reads the repository from disk and supplies the structural baseline.
